programmes.d: AJ overshoots a runway, Joe fires up an old snowplane and the boys get stuck with a water bomber in Turkey.
Devan runs into gear problems when he ferries a mothballed DC3 across the country and a cold snap triggers problems at Buffalo.
Brian and the Electra crew land on the ice strip that caused the crash landing last year. A hotshot Australian pilot tries for a job at Buffalo.
David suffers Devan’s wrath in the C46, Will delivers an ultimatum to the company and Rod and Cory travel to the UK for urgent repairs.
The Air Force invades the hangar and clashes with Chuck. Mikey trains for High Arctic survival. Joe faces tough competition at a California auction.
Mikey scrambles when a freak accident grounds the Electra.
Joe races to England to snap up a new plane, leaving Mikey to handle a crisis that grounds the Electra.
Graeme fumbles his first landing in the Electra, Adam leads a rescue repair mission and Chris fights for a seat in the C46.
Devan preps for fire season in the DC4 tanker while Joe and Mikey head to England to witness the end of an era in aviation.
Joe flies with the Snowbirds and Mikey takes his first pilot lessons.
Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

A giant church steeple makes Natasha question her faith in a forklift, when she's the lone soul to complete the task of loading it. And winter comes for Dwight and Tyesha with a royal run comprising of a beautifully handcrafted throne.
A load of vintage ski gondolas take Molly and Russell from the mountains of Vermont to the Colorado Rockies on a run that is somehow, only an uphill climb.

Natasha heads to the high desert for a showdown when she spearheads the transport of a roller derby track. Meanwhile, Molly and Russ have an unrelaxing spa day, moving the contents of a salon across a small Florida town.
While hauling a flock of live ducks and chickens to a new home, Dwight and Tyesha learn why farm animals don't always make good road companions.

Dwight & Tyesha get some heat when shipping a wrestling ring in Austin and the tight deadline puts them against the ropes. And will Molly & Russell's delivery of a rare blue-eyed baby camel help them get over their fighting hump?
Natasha meets her match during a quest to deliver a massive assortment of arcade games to an anime convention. Doug shows off his trucking gladiator skills while transporting a ninja training course.

While Dwight & Tyesha race to inflate an important delivery for a young entrepreneur, Doug lights up when he gets an opportunity to flex his handyman skills transporting a fragile neon sign to an avid collector in the Windy City.

It's sink or swim for Natasha as she tries to deliver two ultra-rare amphibious cars to the swamps of Louisiana. And out in a desert oasis, Tamara needs to transport a huge tiki hut bar to a tiki-fanatic.
The transporters compete for some unique shipments going cross-country as a 4,000 lbs., 22-foot steel horse and an oversized 7-foot-long Venus Flytrap come up for bid.
When shipments hit the auction block, the Bawcoms score a shipment for a 35-foot freshwater boat while Roy gets stuck transporting an old English phone booth after he tries to teach Jarrett a lesson.

When livestock hits the uShip auction, Jennifer makes her move and wins a haul of two bucking bulls, while Marc gets a fragile experimental aircraft. When this experienced cowgirl picks up the bulls, she finds them meaner than she expected.

After Marc battles it out with the other transporters, he wins a load of two Military tanks headed across the country and Roy lands a mint condition Model A being shipped from one collector to another.
Mike participates in the annual Pageant of the Masters festival where he helps bring Leonardo da Vinci's painting "The Last Supper” to life.
Mike meets a French entrepreneur and chef who uses traditional Mennonite farming methods to produce a better tasting chicken.
Mike visits Disaster City to train with first responders in preparation for any sort of global catastrophe.
Anthony strives to prove himself as medical lead responding to a snowmobile crash on Togwotee Pass.
The first priority of every mission is team safety, so when conditions on Pyramid Peak threaten Jake and Cody
Jake and Marilynn cancel a dinner party so they can respond to an injured skier on Teton Pass.
Dr. AJ Wheeler's hectic schedule keeps him out of action, but his team battles high winds
For Jess, life at home feels out of control. But she's got the work routine dialed in
Jamie puts his trust in new explosives technology to keep ski slopes safe
Wiedie and Chris designed their lives so they can experience all Jackson Hole has to offer.
Tim demands a lot of everyone around him, what he describes as ‚Äúthe worst kind of rescue possible.
Mike literally gets schooled by legendary drag racing instructor Roy Hill.
Mike visits the Derby Dolls, a female roller derby club in San Diego, and trains with members "Isabelle Ringer," "Slamuri," and "Bo Toxic," who endow Mike with the skater name "Skid Rowe."
Mike works with Washed Ashore, a not-for-profit that turns trash found washed up on Oregon’s beaches into beautiful works of nautical-themed art.
Mike joins adrenaline jockeys of the Gravity Car Race Club and MISFITS (Maryland Independent Soapbox Federation and Incline Trial Society), and competes in dangerous downhill racing.
Mike spends the day with former political reporter turned professional forager, Hank Shaw who gets his food off the grid by hunting, fishing, and foraging.
Equestrian and Olympic hopeful Lauren Billys takes Mike through a step-by-step dressage lesson, including dressing him in proper equestrian attire.
Mike helps Tony "Bees" Planakis, a retired New York police officer and current beekeeper, locate and remove 40,000 plus bees from inside the walls of a house.
At the Davenrich European Martial Arts School, Mike dons a suit of armor and then meets and fights Instructor and Swordsman Steaphen Fick.
Mike spends the day at Horn Point Laboratory in Cambridge, Maryland, helping marine biologists repopulate the Chesapeake Bay with oysters.
Mike joins the dudes who make up the YouTube mega sensation trick shooters, Dude Perfect, and creates his own trick shot called Spare Change.
